content.text:
The campaign ran from Oct 22 to Oct 31, 2027 (UK time), and both ad groups have reached their end time. Total spend was $447.17 of the $450 budget.

**Final recap: Haar & Lanterns, UK Halloween run-up**

| | Main post | Ghost studying post | Total |
|---|---|---|---|
| Spend | $239.42 | $207.75 | **$447.17** |
| Impressions | 171,105 | 172,544 | **343,649** |
| Link clicks | 90 | 97 | **187** |
| "Stream opened" events | 65 | 51 | **116** |

- **Budget:** $2.83 went unspent.
- **Stream opened:** The pixel counts conversions from clicks through the landing page to the streaming service. It is a close proxy for streams, not a stream count itself. Check your streaming dashboard for actual plays.
- **Mid-run change:** On Oct 29 I raised both ad groups' daily budget from $22.50 to $25 so the remaining budget would be spent before Halloween. Delivery was otherwise unchanged. Both posts performed about the same, so I didn't reallocate between them.
- **Setup choices:** Both ad groups targeted only the United Kingdom and ran on X's own placements, not third-party publisher sites. Both were optimised for "Stream opened" events.

The campaign is named "Haar & Lanterns - UK Halloween run-up (22-31 Oct 2027)" in the Eerie Close account, and it is now finished.
